title: Ethernet Frame
description: Understand the structure of an Ethernet frame and how data is encapsulated.
scenario: Understand the structure of an Ethernet frame and how data is encapsulated.

concepts.title: Ethernet Frame Structure
concepts.body: An Ethernet frame has: Preamble (7 bytes), SFD (1 byte), Destination MAC (6), Source MAC (6), Length/Type (2), Payload (46-1500), FCS (4).
concepts.code:
Preamble | SFD | Dst MAC | Src MAC | Type | Payload | FCS
   7B  | 1B  |  6B   |  6B   | 2B   | 46-1500B | 4B

concepts.title: Frame Types
concepts.body: Ethernet II (DIX) is the most common. It has a Type field (0x0800 = IPv4, 0x0806 = ARP).
concepts.code:
Type 0x0800 → IPv4 packet
Type 0x0806 → ARP packet

concepts.title: MTU
concepts.body: Maximum Transmission Unit is 1500 bytes for standard Ethernet. Larger packets are fragmented.
concepts.code:
MTU = 1500 bytes (standard Ethernet)
Jumbo frames = 9000 bytes
